name: Insured / applicant
description: The party the contract covers and the party applying.

name: Beneficiary
description: Who receives proceeds; allocations must total 100%.

name: Producer of record
description: The agent/broker credited with the policy.

name: Payer
description: Who pays premium when not the insured.

name: Loss payee / additional interest
description: Lender or interest party named for claim payments.

name: Mortgagee / lienholder
description: Secured parties on property and auto risks.

name: Coverholder / syndicate roles
description: London-market party roles on binder business.

name: Peril catalog
description: Named perils and cause-of-loss codes.

name: Coverage triggers
description: Occurrence vs claims-made trigger definitions.

name: Endorsement attach rules
description: Which endorsements auto-attach for a book or class.

name: Jurisdictional exclusions
description: Terrorism, flood and quake treatment per jurisdiction.

name: Fixed deductible tiers
description: Dollar deductible menus typical of SMB books.

name: Layered excess towers
description: Attachment points and layers for large commercial.

name: Self-insured retentions
description: SIRs the insured funds before the policy responds.

name: Lloyd's line size & order %
description: Capacity as a percentage of the slip order.

name: Base rate tables
description: Rate per exposure unit by class and territory.

name: Schedule rating credits/debits
description: Judgment credits and debits on commercial risks.

name: State rate parameters
description: Minimum premiums, caps and factors filed per state.

name: State amendatory endorsements
description: State-mandated paper attached by risk state.

name: Market wordings (NMA/LMA)
description: Standard London-market wordings referenced by slips.

name: Loss-history gates
description: Loss count and severity eligibility rules.

name: Appetite class exclusions
description: Class codes a book refuses to write.

name: State rate/form filings (SERFF)
description: US filing references per state.

name: Solvency II lines
description: EU/UK line-of-business mapping for reporting.

name: Premium tax regimes
description: Premium tax and surcharge rules per jurisdiction.

name: Channel definitions
description: Direct, agency, broker and coverholder channels.

name: Binding authority limits
description: What a channel may bind without referral.
